channel.title: AI GridWatch — moratorium deadline alerts
channel.description: Data center moratoriums lapsing in the next 90 days, and those that recently lapsed. Derived from documented end dates — moratoriums are often extended, so treat a date as the earliest a pause could end, not proof that it did.

item.title: Armada Township, MI: data center moratorium has lapsed
item.description: The moratorium's documented term ran to 2026-07-13 (54 days ago). Unless it was extended, new applications can be filed again. Confirm the current status with the clerk before relying on either reading.
